title: Create multiple files with numbered or lettered names
summary: Use brace expansion with touch to create several files at once, such as file1, file2, etc., or filea, fileb, etc. This saves you from typing the command multiple times.

steps.explain: Use brace expansion {1..10} to create files named file1 through file10. The shell expands this into ten separate arguments for touch.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: The base name for the files

alternatives.explain: Use brace expansion {a..z} to create files named filea through filez.
